title: Finite-stage square for normalized common-stage evaluation
statement: Fix a prime l, an algebraic closure Omega of Q_l, and a scheme X on which l is invertible. Use the common-stage rational category and tensor/internal Hom of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Let S be a partial closed structure with the finite rational inverse-transpose normalization of [def-sf-adic-closed-reindexing-maps]. For a permitted pair P and a finite field F containing its Hom-object stage, let gammaH be the literal Hom-object identification, isoToStage, and included prescribed rational Hom comparison, and let gammaM and gammaN be isoToStage on the two entries. Then tensor(gammaH,gammaM), followed by the inverse canonical inclusion tensorator of [def-sf-common-stage-inclusion-tensor-comparison] and the included rational evaluation, equals S.evaluation(P) followed by gammaN. This is an equality of the specified arrows, before applying any realization functor.

source.place: Lemma 3.4.11 and Proposition 6.8.14; finite-stage square in step 7 of lem-sf-adic-ambient-hom-evaluation-comparison

proof.text: Write evaluation as inverse transpose of the identity on the common-stage Hom. Its literal object has the compositum of the entry stages as its stage. Hence F contains that Hom, both entries, and the tensor of the Hom with the first entry. Represent the identity at F and apply the assumed PodCommonTransposeNormalization there. Rational inverse transposition is natural in its test object, so move the prescribed rational Hom comparison to the first tensor input; inverse transposition of the identity is rational evaluation.

The stageTensorFormula normalization identifies the inverse inclusion tensorator with the literal tensor-object identification, isoToStage, and commonStageTensorComparison followed by the normalized reflexive scalar units. The representative formula for commonStageDerivedTensor and functoriality of isoToStage identify the input corrections with gammaH and gammaM. Cancel the adjacent scalar units and inverse comparisons. The resulting representative is the included rational evaluation followed by the output correction gammaN.

The two composites now have the same representative at F, so their classes are equal. This argument does not cancel an inclusion functor and assumes no finite-stage faithfulness. Reflexive scalar extensions use the same specified units; zero objects and empty schemes satisfy the same identities.

theorem commonStageEvaluation_finiteSquare
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω]
    [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    (S : PodPartialClosed (commonStageDerivedTensor l Ω X)
      (commonStageHomPairs l Ω X) (commonStageDerivedInternalHom l Ω X))
    (hS : PodCommonTransposeNormalization l Ω X S)
    (P : (commonStageHomPairs l Ω X).FullSubcategory)
    (F : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω)
    (h : (commonStageHomObject l Ω X P).stage ≤ F) :
    let I := GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion (l := l) (Ω := Ω) (Y := X) F
    let Q := commonStageHomPairAtStage l Ω X P F h
    let γH := eqToIso (commonStageDerivedInternalHom_obj_eq l Ω X P)
      ≪≫ (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω X).isoToStage
        (commonStageHomObject l Ω X P) h ≪≫
      I.mapIso (commonStageHomComparison l Ω X P F h)
    let γM := (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω X).isoToStage
      P.obj.1.unop (((Padic.finiteCoefficientFields_properties l Ω).1
        P.obj.1.unop.stage P.obj.2.stage).1.trans h)
    let γN := (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω X).isoToStage
      P.obj.2 (((Padic.finiteCoefficientFields_properties l Ω).1
        P.obj.1.unop.stage P.obj.2.stage).2.trans h)
    (commonStageDerivedTensor l Ω X).map (Prod.mkHom γH.hom γM.hom) ≫
        (AdicQbarRealization.stageTensor l X Ω F
          ((rationalDerivedInternalHom l
            (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω F) X).obj Q)
          Q.obj.1.unop).inv ≫
        I.map ((podRationalClosed l
          (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω F) X).evaluation Q) =
      S.evaluation P ≫ γN.hom
